comment: Native rasterizer golden masters (NativeGoldenMasterTests). sha256 decides pass/fail; parts are per-glyph (or per-file) fingerprints that name what changed. Never edit by hand. If the change is intended, regenerate with KERNSMITH_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 dotnet test --project tests/KernSmith.Rasterizers.Native.Tests -- --filter-class "*NativeGolden*", then review the manifest/PNG diff (see plan/phase-179-validation-golden-masters.md).
